title: Basis-Month Proration Convention by Meal Status Tier
content:
**Convention.** Under the basis-month proration convention of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the tuition credited for the basis month of a Pre-K tuition account is read from the meal tier the child's School Nutrition Services Meal Account holds and the date that tier took effect.

| Meal tier on the child's active meal account | Took effect | Tuition credited for the basis month |
|---|---|---|
| Free Meal Status (Household Application), Reduced-Price Meal Status, Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) or Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | no later than day 15 of the basis month (day 16 less one), or in an earlier month | the whole month's tuition |
| the same tiers | on or after day 16 of the basis month | half of the month's tuition |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) or Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | in or before the basis month | by calendar days on a month of 30 days: the tuition multiplied by the days counted from the effective date (30 less the days from the first of the basis month to the effective date, never more than 30) and divided by 30 |
| any tier | in a month after the basis month | nothing |
| any other tier (such as Paid Meal Status) | any date | nothing |

## Worked credits (hypothetical basis-month tuition charge of 450.00)

| Tier | Effective date | Days from the 1st | Tuition credited |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free Meal Status (Household Application) | the 15th | 14 | 450.00 |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status | the 16th | 15 | 225.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | a date in the previous school year | before the month | 450.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | the 1st | 0 | 450.00 multiplied by 30, divided by 30: 450.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | the 11th | 10 | 450.00 multiplied by 20, divided by 30: 300.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | the 31st | 30 | nothing (30 less 30 days) |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | a date in the previous month | before the month | 450.00 (never more than 30 days counted) |
